title: Capability consumer integration posture static-conformance basis

invariants.invariant: Program Kit-owned C# implementation satisfies the current private repository source-quality policy.
invariants.rationale: The existing private Program Kit source gate already applies to the CLI, serializers, filesystem mechanics, and tests changed by this design.

invariants.invariant: Each supported provider adapter renders only to its exact reviewed project-scoped discovery root.
invariants.rationale: Provider discovery roots, filesystem containment, and external provider behavior require byte-level fixtures and clean-session evidence.

invariants.invariant: Every Program Kit-owned provider wrapper remains represented by exact ownership evidence until explicit exact-byte removal.
invariants.rationale: Lock serialization, migration, collision handling, transactions, and filesystem bytes cannot be proven by a source analyzer.

invariants.invariant: Program Kit never selects a consumer integration posture, changes ignore rules, stages files, commits files, grants provider authority, or starts work.
invariants.rationale: Source dependency checks, command fixtures, documentation conformance, and human review prove the absence of forbidden integration behavior.

purpose: Non-circular exact design basis for the human-selected static-conformance disposition. It creates no new analyzer, gate extension, or consumer attachment.
